unknown_rules.interpretation: Gray load, unmetered support paths, ambiguous active-zero-load or enclosing-geometry overlap remain unknown; invalid is separate and not physical failure. All unknown/invalid/abstentions stay in assigned denominators.
unknown_rules.missing_or_conflicting_reference: INDETERMINATE, never forced to a label

branch.intervention: Remove only target-environment collision permission, preserving all other pairs, controls, mocap, gravity and full integration state
branch.continuation: Recorded open-loop tape, not recovered closed-loop policy
branch.missing: UNREACHABLE/INVALID remains at registered index; no outcome-dependent replacements
branch.dependency_predictor: STOP: natural development force threshold already separated 20 biased cases; no new predictor superiority claim

reference.natural: Simple random sample of 30 rank-1 Allegro scenes and 30 entries per other source, probabilities recorded
reference.diagnostic_role: Separate exploratory convenience sample, never pooled into prevalence
reference.independence: Separate code implementation using raw local contact wrenches, geometry and timestamps; shared simulator and task definitions
reference.access: Single-agent execution; no independent human or agent blinding claimed

roles.fetch: two fingers and gripper palm HAND; other links, table, floor ENV

utility.pool: Unmodified V4.1 repair ordered six candidates
utility.selection: First PASS else abstain; all K full schedules used and charged equally; seal before future outcomes
utility.Y_use: Additional 15s hold-last-command continuation after removing target-environment permissions; all-sample palm-relative displacement <=.03m, angle <=.35rad, speed <=.2m/s; never reads auditor outputs
utility.U1: STOP: two genuine programs, all development scores promote repair; no fabricated checkpoints

statistics.primary_H1: B5 minus B4 correct accepted/assigned controls, empirical accepted risk <=.05; no low-risk population certificate unless risk uncertainty also supports it
statistics.primary_H4: B5 minus B4 usable selected/assigned Allegro scenes at K6; abstention remains failure to provide a usable selection
statistics.intervals: Paired scene bootstrap within fixed mechanism/family strata, 10000 draws, seed 2026100101
statistics.multiplicity: 97.5% two-sided Bonferroni intervals for two confirmatory comparisons; 95% descriptive elsewhere
statistics.additional: FPR/FNR, conditional rates, conservative unknown bounds, accepted risk NA if no acceptance; source/task separate
statistics.clustering: Scene is unit for Allegro, control initialization within mechanism, Fetch seed; DGB clustered by four object identities
statistics.power: Fixed resource budget, not powered to establish 5% gains: worst-case iid 95% rate margins about 6.3pp at N240, 8.9pp at N120, 9.8pp at N100; dependence and few identities widen uncertainty. No post-outcome sample extension.
statistics.zero_difference: No observed gain is not equivalence; no equivalence claim or tolerance is registered

controls_operating_curves.target: Fixed nominal raw-evidence reference; both normalized force and torque change together; no test-based selection

secondary_designs.representation: First eight inactive-margin controls, remove only margin/gap and require complete integration bit equality
secondary_designs.temporal: Thirty intermittent controls: first fifteen periodic, last fifteen one 0.1s support burst at 8s
secondary_designs.coordinate: Legal rigid re-expression checked by offline unit tests only; not extra physical rollout evidence

recovery: Resume only untouched inputs and exact code; completed records hash-verified. Orphan/failed attempts retained and reported. Any semantic code/protocol/data/physics change voids confirmation and requires a deviation record; no quiet lock replacement.
allowed_claims: Contract-specific measurement reliability within registered apparatus and task definitions
Short-horizon intervention-conditioned dependence distinct from historical no-load/no-contact
Conditional utility only if frozen paired outcomes and uncertainty support it
prohibited_claims: New temporal logic, force closure or evaluator selection principle

qualification.development_baseline: B4 and B5 tied; no positive additional-geometry claim assumed
